# Code of conduct

Exo Launcher is a small project, and everyone who joins in should feel welcome.

- Be kind and patient, including when you disagree.
- Talk about the work, not the person.
- No harassment, insults, or sexual or discriminatory language or images.
- Don't share anyone's personal details without their permission.

This applies in issues, pull requests, Discussions and anywhere else you represent the project.

If someone breaks these rules, report it at [getexo.app/help](https://getexo.app/help) and say it is a conduct report; it is read privately. The maintainer may remove comments, lock threads or block people who don't follow them.
